facets.description: getShortcut() documents 3-letter shortcuts, but getTokenContextFromTokenId() requires 2-character grant shortcuts, breaking custom-grant token round-trips.
DefaultTokenContextEncoderProviderFactory.postInit() does not validate grant shortcut lengths.
encodeTokenId() concatenates grant shortcuts without validating their length.
getTokenContextFromTokenId() throws for colon-containing IDs with non-6-character prefixes instead of falling back to UNKNOWN/legacy handling.
